The lighting is warm and artificial, reflecting off the glass surfaces. The background shows the interior of the shop through the glass, slightly out of focus.

artifact_observations.location: Pastries on middle and bottom shelves
artifact_observations.reasoning: Several pastries exhibit 'melting' or indistinct boundaries where they touch the tray or each other. The texture of the fillings (e.g., center bottom pastry) appears smudged and lacks the crisp definition of real food photography, suggesting AI generation smoothing.

The horizontal lines of the glass shelves warp and wobble slightly rather than being perfectly straight rigid lines. The vertical supports/reflections in the glass are inconsistent and seem to merge with the background, indicating weak geometric grounding.
The window frame in the background has irregular thickness and slightly non-Euclidean angles, typical of AI struggling with rigid architectural lines in the depth plane.
